description: Open the first row text editor, type with real keystrokes, commit with Enter.
limits: Product limits unchanged: 200 rows per column and 1200 rows per board. The fixture uses at most 199 rows per column so one moved row never exceeds the limit; sizes above 1200 spill into extra boards in the same document.
Fresh page per sample: the recorded action is the first interaction of that action after load (JIT-cold for the action path), not a warmed steady state.
Events are trusted Playwright input; nextFrameMs is the first animation frame after the handler, not painted-frame completion, field INP, or peak memory.
asyncSettledMs is event start to answered save request, no pending fetch and idle save indicator; it includes the sync queue debounce and local server time.

Load family: start is navigation start; asyncSettledMs is the last state/people response; handlerMs is render commit after that response; nextFrameMs is the first frame after commit. Static files are fulfilled from exact build artifacts, so this is not network download timing.
The in-page fetch ledger and a Playwright route are identical for both backends.
